svg.title: The brownfield path
svg.desc: A top-to-bottom path of seven numbered stages in three grouped panels. Look and decide: 1 Take stock, 2 Choose a path, 3 Plan the target. Build beside, then test: 4 Build beside, 5 See the effect. Move and finish: 6 Move in, 7 Finish. Each stage shows what you decide and what you end up with. Arrows lead from each stage to the next. A loop arrow from stage 6 back to stage 5 is labelled repeat for each wave. Redraw by the author, not an official Microsoft diagram.
